title: SlotDisabler
description: Challenge mod for 1.16.1 speedrunning that lets you restrict your inventory size. Requires speedrunapi.
body: Challenge mod for 1.16.1 speedrunning that lets you restrict your inventory size. Inventory size can be changed via the speedrunapi settings page. Requires [speedrunapi](https://github.com/contariaa/SpeedrunAPI/releases) as a dependency.
